verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a security posture. There is no statement of what the skill's bundled tools may execute, no trust model for third-party skills, and no telemetry or data-collection disclosure. Mentions of dependency-free Python tools and a local gallery describe features, not security documentation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, the project documents its security posture — what skills can execute, the trust model for third-party skills, and any telemetry or data collection
